repair_summary: Semantic compression and differentiation pass; universal HCD fields moved to one canonical review gate; records use family-specific schemas.
records_kept: Strong source inventory, metadata, terminology distinctions, source map, risk registry intent, HCD source layer, and operational extension layer were preserved as V1 assets.
records_merged: Universal HCD boilerplate that appeared across large record families was merged into hcd-canonical-review-gate and targeted family schemas.
records_removed: Duplicate/redundant V0 records that differed mainly by source anchor or generic universal fields were not carried forward as separate records.
records_rewritten: Human-error, mapping, feedback, constraints, knowledge, conceptual model, forms, failure-mode, diagnostic-question, operational, and AI workflow records were rewritten with concept-specific fields.
records_added_from_source_recheck: current verification flags linked to canonical IDs
source_traceability_repair: Direct claims were rewritten as source-level claims; operational/form/status/AI applications are in inferred_claims, source_supported_elements, operational_extensions, or derivation boundary notes.
ai_cross_reference_repair: AI workflows now use source_record_ids_to_consult for real canonical IDs and record_groups_to_consult for defined group names.
